prompt: Return JSON code/report. Implement standalone resolver.py resolve_hits(hits) mutating and returning list of hit dictionaries. Each hit has entry {feature_id,canonical_name}, location Biopython location, identity,coverage,confidence,status (new/existing/conflict). Only compare same strand and reciprocal overlap >=0.8 (intersection divided by each location length). Use set(location). Group competing hits via pairwise comparisons. If another overlapping hit has strictly higher tuple(identity,coverage), set lower hit status='superseded' and confidence='Moderate confidence'. Do not downgrade higher hit. Equal evidence same canonical_name casefold: retain lexicographically smallest feature_id, other status superseded. Equal evidence different canonical names: status conflict and confidence Moderate confidence for both, unless already superseded. Existing hits must keep status existing. Do comparisons in two passes: first supersession then conflicts among non-superseded hits. Existing hits can suppress duplicate new hit if identical occupied bases and same strand; keep existing status. Return all hits for diagnostics. Under 85 lines. No CLI or network.
